frame_series.spectral_tilt_definition: Local log-spectrum slope in dB/octave over retained 200-5000 Hz bins by default.

local_vibrato.extent_definition: Local detrended selected-F0 p95 minus p05; exploratory vibrato-oriented descriptor, not an assertion of intentional vibrato.
local_vibrato.rate_definition: Dominant detrended selected-F0 modulation frequency in the 3-9 Hz band when enough contiguous data are present.

praat_timeseries.cpps_definition: Per-frame CPP from the same calibrated PowerCepstrogram after 0.01 s time and 0.001 s quefrency smoothing used by the M6 CPPS configuration.
praat_timeseries.hnr_definition: Praat Sound: To Harmonicity (cc), 0.01 s step, 75 Hz pitch floor, 0.1 silence threshold, 1.0 period/window; sampled at PowerCepstrogram frame times.
